description: List drafts, newest first: of one inbox (inbox_id) or of the whole workspace. Filter by status, e.g. ["draft", "scheduled"] for the ones still waiting, or "failed" for scheduled sends that were refused (their error says why).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: the next_cursor value from a previous call.

inbox_id.description: Only this inbox. Omit for every inbox.

thread_id.description: Only drafts replying in this thread.
